mapper.select: SELECT bi.*, m.name AS material_name, m.code AS material_code FROM pl_bom_item bi LEFT JOIN material m ON m.id = bi.material_id WHERE bi.bom_id = #{bomId} ORDER BY bi.item_type ASC

SELECT bi.*, m.name AS material_name, m.code AS material_code, cb.bom_code AS child_bom_code, cb.bom_name AS child_bom_name FROM pl_bom_item bi LEFT JOIN material m ON m.id = bi.material_id LEFT JOIN pl_bom cb ON cb.id = bi.child_bom_id WHERE bi.bom_id = #{bomId} ORDER BY bi.item_type ASC
